rb_customize_title: 🎨 Customize your sales bot Choose what to change:
rb_customize_text_ask: Send the new text. It will be saved for your current language (up to {max} characters).
rb_customize_text_invalid: Send a non-empty text up to {max} characters.
rb_customize_logo_ask: Send a photo to show before /start, or send - to remove it.
rb_customize_logo_invalid: Send a photo, or - to remove the current image.
rb_customize_channel_ask: Send the channel's username (like @my_channel) or its link. For a private channel: -100... | https://t.me/+invite Your bot must be an admin there. Send - to remove every channel.
rb_channels_hint: Your bot's customers must join these channels before using it. Your bot must be an admin in each. Tap a channel to remove it.
rb_channel_err_bot_not_admin: ❗️ Your bot is not an admin in this channel. Make it an admin, then send the channel again.
rb_channel_err_channel_not_found: ❗️ Channel not found. Check the username and that your bot is in the channel.
rb_channel_err_channel_limit: You reached the limit of channels.
rb_channel_err_link_required: ❗️ The channel is private; send its invite link too: -100... | https://t.me/+...
rb_channel_err_bot_stopped: ❗️ Your bot is not running; turn it on first.
